title: Philips Hue Bridge Not Found
shortDescription: The Hue app cannot find the Bridge on the network.
fullDescription:
When the Hue app can't find the Bridge, it's usually because the phone and Bridge aren't on the same subnet, or the router blocks discovery traffic.

Reboot the Bridge (blue LEDs should be lit) and ensure it's on the same network as the phone.

fixSteps.title: Verify LEDs
fixSteps.instruction: All three LEDs on Bridge should be blue.

fixSteps.title: Same network
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm phone WiFi is on same router as Bridge Ethernet.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue Bridge not found fix

faq.a: Yes, Bridge connects to router via Ethernet only.

title: Philips Hue Bulb Unreachable
shortDescription: Bridge cannot reach a specific bulb.
fullDescription:
A bulb marked unreachable has lost Zigbee signal to the Bridge. The wall switch may have been turned off, the bulb is too far from the Bridge, or a Zigbee repeater failed.

Ensure power, and add more Hue fixtures to extend the mesh.

fixSteps.title: Check wall switch
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure the switch is on so bulb has power.

fixSteps.title: Add Zigbee hop
fixSteps.instruction: Add a Hue bulb between the Bridge and the far bulb.

faq.a: Yes every Hue powered device acts as repeater.

title: Philips Hue Pairing Failed
shortDescription: Bulb does not pair with the Bridge.
fullDescription: Pairing fails if the bulb is still joined to another Bridge or Zigbee network. Use Touchlink reset (hold Hue Dimmer close to bulb and press setup) or search by serial number in the Hue app.

fixSteps.title: Add by serial
fixSteps.instruction: In Hue app, add light and enter the 6-char serial.

fixSteps.title: Touchlink reset
fixSteps.instruction: Use Hue dimmer switch on/off buttons held near bulb to reset.

faq.a: Printed on bulb side near threads.

title: Philips Hue Sync Box Error
shortDescription: Play HDMI Sync Box not working.
fullDescription: The Hue Sync Box encounters errors when HDMI handshake fails, firmware is outdated, or the entertainment area in the Hue app is misconfigured.

fixSteps.title: Firmware update
fixSteps.instruction: Update Sync Box via Hue Sync app.

fixSteps.title: Reseat HDMI
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect and reconnect all HDMI cables in order.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue Sync Box error fix

title: Hue Bridge Firmware Error
fullDescription: Bridge firmware updates are automatic. Failures cause the Bridge to retry, but if LEDs are irregular a manual power cycle helps.
videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue Bridge firmware error fix

title: Philips Hue Voice Control Error
shortDescription: Alexa or Google cannot control Hue lights.
fullDescription: Voice assistants need the Hue skill/service linked. Token expiration, skill errors, or account changes can break the link.

fixSteps.title: Re-link skill
fixSteps.instruction: In Alexa or Google Home app, disable and re-enable Hue skill.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue voice control error fix

faq.a: Bluetooth-only control doesn't, but skills need Bridge.

title: Philips Hue Automation Not Working
fullDescription: Automations may fail when the Bridge loses internet (for sunset/sunrise), location services are off, or the automation is paused.
symptoms: Lights don't trigger at scheduled time

fixSteps.title: Set home location
fixSteps.instruction: In Hue app, set home location for sunset/sunrise.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue automation not working fix

faq.a: Timer-based ones work offline; sunset needs internet.

title: Philips Hue Scene Not Applying
shortDescription: Selected scene does not change lights.
fullDescription: Scenes may not apply if a light in the scene is unreachable, the scene was created before a bulb was swapped, or the group definition is stale.

fixSteps.title: Recreate scene
fixSteps.instruction: Delete and recreate scene in app.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue scene not applying fix

title: Philips Hue Dimmer Switch Pairing Failed
shortDescription: Hue Dimmer switch won't pair to Bridge.
fullDescription: The Hue Dimmer switch can operate standalone via Touchlink or pair to the Bridge. Pairing can fail if the switch is too far from the Bridge or its battery is low.

fixSteps.title: Pair near Bridge
fixSteps.instruction: Bring switch within 1 meter of Bridge during pairing.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue dimmer switch pairing fix

title: Philips Hue Motion Sensor Not Triggering
shortDescription: Motion sensor fails to detect movement.
fullDescription:
The Hue motion sensor may fail to trigger due to low battery, blocked field of view, or misconfigured daylight threshold.

Check sensor position and battery.

fixSteps.title: Adjust daylight
fixSteps.instruction: Lower the daylight threshold in Hue app.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue motion sensor not triggering fix

title: Philips Hue Routine Error
fullDescription: Routines fail when the underlying automation is paused, the schedule overlap occurs, or Bridge loses time sync.

fixSteps.title: Reboot Bridge
fixSteps.instruction: Power cycle the Bridge to sync time.

title: Philips Hue Alexa Skill Error
shortDescription: Hue Alexa skill returns error or lights not found.
fullDescription:
The Hue Alexa skill can return errors when the OAuth link expires or when the Bridge is offline.

Disable the skill, reconnect and rediscover devices.

fixSteps.title: Relink skill
fixSteps.instruction: Alexa app > Skills > Hue > Disable, then Enable and link.

fixSteps.title: Discover devices
fixSteps.instruction: After linking, ask Alexa discover devices.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue Alexa skill error fix

faq.a: Bluetooth skill is more limited; skill via Bridge offers full control.

title: Philips Hue Bridge offline
shortDescription: Hue Bridge LED 2 (cloud) off; app says no bridge.
fullDescription: Bridge offline due to Ethernet drop, ISP outage, or stale cloud token. Verify all 4 LEDs on top of v2 bridge.

fixSteps.title: Press link button
fixSteps.instruction: Press and re-add bridge to app.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue smart bulb BRIDGE OFFLINE fix

title: Hue bulb shows unreachable
shortDescription: Single bulb greyed out as Unreachable.
fullDescription: Bulb unreachable usually means power switch off, mesh range issue, or bulb to be re-paired. Add another bulb between bridge and target to extend Zigbee mesh.

fixSteps.title: Bridge mesh hop
fixSteps.instruction: Add bulb between bridge and far bulb.

fixSteps.title: Touchlink reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold dimmer switch on/off near bulb 10s.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue smart bulb BULB UNREACHABLE fix

title: Hue scene editor crashes
shortDescription: Scene save fails with error or app crash.
fullDescription: App cache or 200-scene limit per room can cause editor crash. Delete unused scenes and update app.
videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue smart bulb SCENE EDITOR ERROR fix

title: Hue Sync Box no input
shortDescription: Sync Box LED red; no HDMI input detected.
fullDescription: Sync Box requires HDMI 2.0 4K@60Hz HDR; some receivers downscale. Reset HDMI handshake and verify cable.
videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue smart bulb SYNC BOX NO SIGNAL fix

title: Hue bulb flickers
shortDescription: Bulb flickers at low brightness or with dimmer switch.
fullDescription: Hue bulbs are full brightness internally; flicker at <5% or when wired through legacy dimmer. Remove dimmer; use Hue dimmer or app instead.
videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue smart bulb BULB FLICKER fix

title: Hue bulb wrong power-on color
shortDescription: Bulb turns on warm white instead of last setting.
fullDescription: Hue Power-on Behavior in v4+ app sets default state. Configure per bulb.
videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue smart bulb POWER ON DEFAULT WRONG fix

title: Hue Bridge link button not responding
shortDescription: Pressing link button doesn't pair app/voice.
fullDescription: Link button window is 30s. Slow taps or LED feedback failure cause perceived non-response.

fixSteps.title: Retry within 30s
fixSteps.instruction: Tap Pair in app first, then bridge button.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue smart bulb BRIDGE LINK BUTTON FAIL fix

title: Hue dimmer or motion sensor not found
fullDescription: Accessory pairing requires fresh batteries, proximity to bridge, and reset on the device.
videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue smart bulb ACCESSORY NOT FOUND fix

title: Hue Entertainment area broken
shortDescription: Sync with PC/Razer Chroma drops or never starts.
fullDescription: Entertainment areas use UDP streaming via bridge; firewall, mesh hopping, or 50-bulb cap causes drops.
videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue smart bulb ENTERTAINMENT AREA FAIL fix

title: Hue bulb stuck on after command
shortDescription: Bulb won't turn off via app or voice.
fullDescription: Stuck-on bulbs may be desynced from bridge or have a corrupt state. Power-cycle wall switch 5x to factory reset.

fixSteps.title: Off via app and physical
fixSteps.instruction: Toggle wall switch then app off.

fixSteps.title: 5x power-cycle reset
fixSteps.instruction: On/off 5 times to factory reset bulb.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Hue smart bulb BULB STUCK ON fix

title: Hue Bridge firmware update stuck at 50%
fullDescription: Hue Bridge v2 occasionally stalls during firmware push if Ethernet cable is flapping or DNS times out.

fixSteps.title: Reseat Ethernet
fixSteps.instruction: Both ends, try different switch port.

title: Hue Play HDMI Sync Box drops 4K120/HDR with 2.1 source
shortDescription: Sync Box drops to 4K60 or no signal with PS5/Xbox.
fullDescription: Sync Box (2019) is HDMI 2.0b only. 4K120 / 8K / VRR can't pass through. Need Sync Box V2 (2024).

causes.cause: HDMI cable not Ultra High Speed

fixSteps.title: Use Ultra High Speed HDMI cable

title: Hue Motion Sensor batteries last only 6 months
shortDescription: AAA cells deplete in 6 months instead of 2 years.
fullDescription: Sensor sensitivity at max + cold/outdoor location drains AAAs fast. Use lithium AAAs.

code: BULB WON'T RESET AFTER OLD HUB
displayCode: Bulb Won't Reset After Old Hub
title: Hue bulb still tied to old Bridge / Echo zigbee
shortDescription: Bulb won't onboard to new Bridge.
fullDescription: Zigbee bulbs remember old coordinator. Use Hue Dimmer Switch reset (hold on+off near bulb 10s) or Touchlink reset.

fixSteps.title: Hue Dimmer reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold on+off button 10s within 4in of bulb.

fixSteps.title: Touchlink via Bridge
fixSteps.instruction: Search for new lights, multiple times.

title: Hue Tap Dial Switch can't pair to bridge
fullDescription: Tap Dial requires Bridge firmware 1956+ and Hue app v4.x. Older bridges still support it after firmware push.

title: Hue Bridge cloud disconnected (out of home control gone)
shortDescription: Cannot control lights away from home.
fullDescription: Cloud link drops when MyHue account region changes or bridge rejected SSL update.

fixSteps.title: Sign out and back in to MyHue

title: Hue Lightstrip Plus extension dim past 80in
shortDescription: After 2nd extension strip drops in brightness.
fullDescription: Lightstrip Plus voltage drop after 80in (5m+) needs power injection. Add second power supply at strip end.
symptoms: Far end dim or color wrong

title: Hue Wall Switch Module unresponsive after install
shortDescription: Battery module installed behind switch but bridge can't see it.
fullDescription: Module's Zigbee signal blocked by metal box. Move bridge closer or add Zigbee repeater bulb in same room.

title: Hue Festavia string lights random pixels dark
shortDescription: Some pixels stay dark in scene.
fullDescription: Festavia string with cold weather can have intermittent pixel comm. Update firmware and ensure first pixel within 10in of plug.

causes.cause: First pixel too far from plug

title: Hue Secure camera doesn't record without plan
shortDescription: Camera shows live but not events.
fullDescription: Hue Secure cloud event recording requires monthly plan. Local recording requires SD card and Bridge.
